name: morningside-k3s
description: Check, start, and gracefully shut down the existing local Morningside K3s environment on Apple silicon.

interface.longDescription:
Check your local Morningside K3s environment, start it for a development session, and gracefully shut down its VM when you finish.

For developers with an existing Morningside environment on an Apple silicon Mac. Requires Python 3.9 or later, Lima 2.3 or later, and the ARM64 VZ instance morningside-k3s-v001 in the default Lima home. The instance must already have the Alpine OpenRC k3s service and noninteractive guest sudo access. Complete environment setup before using the plugin.

Status reports the Lima VM state and OpenRC service state. A running service does not establish workload readiness. Checking status leaves a stopped VM stopped. Shutdown interrupts active work and retains the VM disk.

Runs locally in the desktop app.
defaultPrompt: Check whether Morningside K3s is running.

prompts: Check whether Morningside K3s is running while its VM is stopped.
Start my existing Morningside K3s environment and tell me whether the service is running.
Shut down Morningside K3s and tell me whether the shutdown completed.

publication.release_notes: Initial desktop release for checking, starting, and gracefully shutting down an existing Morningside K3s environment on Apple silicon using Lima and OpenRC.
